# Problem 1b

In this lab, we used the result of a from part 1a to find the correct file we 
would need to analyze. Then, we loaded the file, and computed the mean, median,
standard deviation, min, and max using the d-th (column 8) column given in the 
'datasets.xlsx' file.

```{r}
# load data
data <- read.csv("7/abalone.data",
                 header = FALSE)

# mean
dMean <- mean(data$V8)
sprintf(dMean, fmt = '%.3f')

# median
dMedian <- median(data$V8)
sprintf(dMedian, fmt = '%.3f')

# standard deviation
dSD <- sd(data$V8)
sprintf(dSD, fmt = '%.3f')

# minimum
dMin <- min(data$V8)
sprintf(dMin, fmt = '%.3f')

# maximum
dMax <- max(data$V8)
sprintf(dMax, fmt = '%.3f')
```
